tasks.gr6-common-fractions-t2: Topic: Common fractions. Cover equivalent fractions, simplifying fractions using the HCF, finding fractions with the same denominator, and adding and subtracting fractions. Ask Grade 6 learners to simplify, compare, add, and subtract common fractions and explain their working.
tasks.gr6-decimal-fractions-t2: Topic: Decimal fractions. Cover the meaning of tenths and hundredths, converting fractions to decimals, reading decimals on a number line, and adding and subtracting decimals. Ask Grade 6 learners to convert between fractions and decimals, add and subtract decimals, and solve decimal problems in context.
tasks.gr6-number-sentences-t2: Topic: Number sentences and equations. Cover translating word problems into number sentences, identifying the unknown, using symbols for unknowns, and solving for unknown values. Ask Grade 6 learners to write equations from word problems, identify unknowns, and solve for missing values.
tasks.gr6-patterns-t2: Topic: Number patterns and flow diagrams. Cover extending patterns using rules (add and multiply), two-step flow diagrams, and predicting terms in a sequence. Ask Grade 6 learners to identify rules, extend patterns, complete flow diagrams, and explain the relationship between input and output.
